name: Saharanpur
scopeLimits: The WUP point is a settlement locator, not a municipal boundary. District-level land-record availability and village-map digitization do not establish city parcel coverage. No login, parcel-number or owner query was attempted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The district land-record service explicitly identifies its location as Tehsil Headquarter, City Saharanpur, and links official UP Bhulekh. This city-specific service establishes local land-record activity, without verifying public parcel polygons.
technicalBlocker: The city GIS viewer is login-gated. State land-map routes are village/patta workflows; no anonymous city-level full-polygon response was confirmed.
remainingUncertainty: Whether authenticated municipal GIS offers urban geometry and whether a public urban-survey layer exists for the WUP point.
nextStep: Use only a documented anonymous city parcel-vector service if found; do not query the login viewer.
